name: MLA-NoPE
tagline: Multi-head latent attention without rotary dimensions, as used in the KDA hybrid.
description: Full causal multi-head latent attention in every layer: a 768-rank query latent, a 256-rank joint key/value latent, 12 heads with QK and V dimensions of 128, no rotary dimensions, and no value embeddings. It is the independently calibrated MLA control for the KDA + MLA-NoPE hybrid.
paperTitle: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
mechanism: 26 MLA-NoPE layers: query latent 768, joint KV latent 256, 12 heads of 128, no RoPE
Explicit K/V reconstruction for training; parameter-free RMSNorm on both latents
limitations: No reconstructed-head QK norm or output gate; a separately registered QK-normalized MLA has its own result. Registered and admitted within the shared budget; no formal result is published yet. Parameters, memory and speed are outcomes, not controls.
